The Strategy Analyst supports the development, execution, and monitoring of enterprise strategy by providing data-driven analysis, in depth research, marketing intelligence, and insights that guide executive decision making. This role plays a critical part in the strategic planning process translating complex transformation into actionable recommendations, supporting strategic initiatives, and ensuring alignment between organizational priorities and measurable outcomes. The Strategy Analyst will work closely with business leaders and product leadership to evaluate opportunities, track progress, and strengthen accountability for results.

Strategic Planning Support: Play a key role in enterprise strategic planning process by conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, building financial and operational scenarios, and synthetizing insights into clear recommendations. Support quarterly, annual, and multi-year planning cycles by preparing executive and board level materials, coordinating inputs across business units, and ensuring that strategic priorities are well-defined, measurable, and aligned with business goals. Objective thought partner to senior level executives and support creation of CEO level executive communications. (25%)
Research and Market Intelligence: Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, competitor strategies, regulatory developments and member/partner needs. Transform complex research findings into actionable intelligence that highlights opportunities, risks, and implications for the organization’s long-term positioning. (20%)
Performance Tracking and Reporting: Design, maintain, and enhance enterprise dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs to monitor progress against strategic goals. Ensure executives and the board have timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into performance, enabling course corrections and accountability across the organization. Build robust data models in excel for dynamic scenario analysis that supports business cases and strategic priority analysis. (15%)
Business Case Development: Build financial and operational models to evaluate new initiatives, products, or partnerships. Provide clear analysis of expected ROI, risks, and alignment with organizational priorities, enabling leaders to make informed, data-driven investment decisions. (15%)
Executive and Board Materials: Prepare concise, high-quality presentations, reports, and briefing documents that translate complex data, analysis, and research into clear narratives. Provide executive leadership and the board with the insights that they need to evaluate progress, approve initiatives, and set direction. (15%)
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Operations, PMO & CMO, Product, and Data & Analytics teams to embed strategy into day-to-day execution. Facilitate alignment between departments, clarify ownership of initiatives, and ensure strategic priorities are advanced through coordinated, cross-functional action. Ensures proper policies, procedures, risk mitigation activities, and operating controls are followed. Reports gaps in policies, procedures, and operating controls to leadership to ensure member impact and risk is mitigated. (10%)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field. Masters Degree or MBA preferred.
3-5 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, finance, analytics, or related roles with demonstrated ability to conduct research, develop business cases, and support executive decision-making.
Experience supporting strategic planning processes and developing board ready materials in a corporate, financial services, or consulting environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Experience in applying data analysis to solve business problems in fast-moving environments.
Strategic Planning Tools & Frameworks: Proficiency in frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, balanced scorecards, and OKRs to evaluate organizational positioning and define priorities.
Financial & Quantitative Analysis: Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; ability to build ROI models, sensitivity analyses, and scenario forecasts to support business cases and strategy recommendations.
Research & Competitive Intelligence: Ability to conduct primary and secondary research, synthesize market trends, competitor moves, and regulatory developments into actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: Strong skills in developing executive-ready presentations and board materials that translate complex data and analysis into clear, compelling narratives.
Critical Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to evaluate ambiguous business problems, identify root causes, and propose practical, data-driven solutions.
Technology Awareness: Working knowledge of data infrastructure, analytics platforms, and emerging technologies (AI, automation, digital transformation tools) to assess innovation opportunities; preferred.

Data Analysis & Visualization: Skilled in extracting, analyzing, and presenting data using BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar). Comfortable with SQL for querying and joining datasets; preferred.

From system enhancements and workflow automation to process redesign, data insights and reporting, you’ll contribute to strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, strengthen governance and enhance organisational performance.

If you’re a strategic thinker, natural problem solver and confident stakeholder partner who enjoys turning ideas into action, this could be the opportunity for you!

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

This is a full-time, flexible hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration. There is no mandate on the number of days required but we encourage employees to come in every week to collaborate.

About This Role

We’re hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Revenue
to support our CFO and Finance organization on some of the most complex and consequential analytical problems at Fivetran. This role sits at the intersection of finance, data, and applied mathematics, with a focus on understanding, forecasting, and modeling the economic engine of the business.

You’ll develop sophisticated models for revenue attribution, forecasting, customer behavior, and financial performance; build the underlying data infrastructure that powers company-wide reporting; and partner directly with Finance and executive leadership on decisions that shape the business.

This is a highly quantitative role for someone with exceptional numerical intuition, rigorous logical thinking, and an unusually high bar for accuracy. You’ll work on problems where small errors can have meaningful downstream consequences, and where the best solution often requires going beyond standard reporting into mathematical modeling, statistical methods, or machine learning.

If you enjoy decomposing ambiguous business problems into precise mathematical frameworks, stress-testing assumptions, and building models that become foundational to how a company operates, this role offers the opportunity to work on some of our hardest analytical challenges.

Technologies You’ll Use

SQL (BigQuery / Snowflake)
dbt / dbt State
Looker / LookML
Sigma / Hex / Google Sheets
Claude Code / Codex
Netsuite, CRM, and customer data and billing systems

What You’ll Do

Develop sophisticated revenue models. Build, maintain, and improve complex mathematical models used to project, attribute, analyze, and understand Fivetran’s revenue, customers, and underlying business drivers. Work in an environment with a strong emphasis on mathematical reasoning, robust logic, numerical precision, and analytical rigor.
Own revenue attribution and financial logic. Design frameworks that accurately connect revenue to customers, products, contracts, usage, and other business dimensions, including complex attribution problems that require careful mathematical treatment.
Build and improve revenue forecasting. Develop models that project revenue and customer behavior using historical trends, leading indicators, statistical methods, and machine learning. Continuously evaluate forecast accuracy and improve model performance over time.
Build scalable analytical infrastructure. Create data models, pipelines, and automated systems that are reliable, optimized, and scalable, enabling timely analytics and reporting for more than 2,000 stakeholders across the company.
Maintain an exceptionally high bar for quality. Develop rigorous validation, testing, and quality-assurance processes for financial data and analytical models. Identify edge cases, challenge assumptions, and ensure outputs can withstand scrutiny from Finance and executive leadership.
Partner closely with Finance leadership. Work directly with the CFO organization and cross-functional leaders to translate complex business questions into analytical frameworks, define business rules, establish metrics and targets, and communicate findings clearly.
Drive executive-level decision making. Conduct high-impact, in-depth analyses that inform company strategy, financial planning, resource allocation, growth initiatives, and other critical business decisions.
Embody ownership and operational excellence. Take responsibility for the correctness and reliability of your work, continuously improve existing systems and methodologies, and raise the analytical bar for the broader team.

Skills We’re Looking For

4+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
Advanced proficiency in SQL and data modeling, with experience working across large, complex datasets
Exceptional quantitative ability and numerical intuition, with a strong foundation in mathematics, logic, statistics, and analytical problem-solving
Experience using Looker, Tableau, Sigma, or similar business intelligence and visualization tools
Strong analytical judgment and a track record of translating ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data quality, analytical rigor, and reproducibility
Excellent communication and data storytelling skills; you can make complex findings intuitive and help decision-makers understand not just what is happening, but why it matters and what to do next
Comfort operating in ambiguity, developing hypotheses, and owning analytical problems end-to-end
Strong cross-functional instincts and the ability to build trusted relationships with both technical and non-technical partners
A builder mindset: you look beyond answering one-off questions and create frameworks, datasets, and tools that make future decisions faster and better
Passion for using data to improve how organizations attract, develop, and support their people
Experience using analytics to support key business decisions, preferably at a high-growth, SaaS, or B2B product company

jobs.description:
Job Description

Sr. Spclst, Data Business Analyst

The Opportunity

Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Data Scientist / Business Analyst to join the HTC team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate in developing robust data standards and ontologies while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will play a critical role in translating laboratory, quality, and operational needs into clearly defined, testable, and traceable requirements, ensuring our data ecosystems are connected, contextualized, and compliant.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Alignment

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to bridge the gap between laboratory operations and IT solutions.
Translate laboratory, quality, and operational needs into clearly defined, testable, and traceable requirements.
Own end-to-end requirements lifecycle management, business process definition, and ensure strict traceability between intended business outcomes and delivered system functionality.
Ensure integration solutions align with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and end‑user workflows.

Data Strategy, Ontologies, & Contextualization

Develop and document data‑standardization strategies, ontology utilization guidelines, and application‑governance practices for LIMS and LES data objects to enable harmonized, FAIR‑aligned data management.
Support and orchestrate the alignment of chromatographic ASM structures between Research and Manufacturing divisions to ensure consistent standards, terminology, and execution logic across domains.

Systems Architecture & Integration

Lead the design and facilitation of cross‑platform data‑flow architectures spanning environments such as Biovia LES, CISPro, MODA-EM, Empower, and enterprise data lakes.
Ensure seamless integration delivery through platforms including Scitara DLX, Empower, BIOVIA, MODA-EM, SoftMaxPro, Labware LIMS, and LabX.

Risk Management & Governance

Independently conduct data‑strategy risk assessments.
Clearly communicate assessment findings to project leadership, ensuring proactive visibility into system, workflow, and interoperability risks.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in Business Analysis or Data Science within a laboratory, scientific, or pharmaceutical environment.
Strong understanding of FAIR data principles, ontologies, and data contextualization.
Familiarity with lab informatics and integration platforms (e.g., Scitara DLX, Empower, BIOVIA, Labware LIMS, LabX, CISPro, MODA-EM, SoftMaxPro).
Exceptional ability to define and manage business processes, requirements lifecycles, and cross-functional traceability.
Strong analytical, communication, and risk-assessment capabilities.

Education & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (preferred fields Engineering, Life Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline).
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in regulated environments (pharmaceutical, life sciences, or manufacturing preferred).
Demonstrated experience working within SDLC and validation frameworks (GxP, cGMP).
Strong understanding of lab operations, quality systems, or laboratory informatics.
Excellent written, verbal, and facilitation skills.
Ability to work independently and influence across organizational boundaries.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting lab systems (Empower, BIOVIA, MODA-EM, LabwareLIMS, Scitara DLX).
Certified PMI-PBA or IIBA-CBAP or CCBA
Familiarity with change control processes (e.g. Veeva) and digital SDLC (e.g. Kneat).
Experience with digital workflows, data integrity, and compliance‑driven implementations.
Hands‑on experience with Jira, Confluence, and requirements traceability tools (e.g., Xray).

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Required Skills

Asset Management, Benefits Management, Business Processes, Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Modeling, Business Requirements Analysis, Computer Science, Data Integrity, Data Strategies, Laboratory Informatics, Management System Development, Product Management, Project Leadership, Requirements Management, Stakeholder Analysis, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, System Designs, Systems Architecture, Working Independently

jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.

Lead complex enterprise customer engagements that modernize contact centers, improve customer experiences, and accelerate adoption of Genesys solutions. As a Senior Project Manager within Genesys Professional Services, you will own end-to-end delivery of high-visibility cloud, SaaS, and customer experience transformation initiatives, balancing customer objectives, delivery quality, financial performance, and measurable business outcomes.

Operating with significant autonomy, you will serve as a trusted advisor to customer executives while directing geographically distributed teams across solution architecture, consulting, engineering, change management, operations, and strategic partners. Your leadership will establish clear governance, accelerate decisions, manage complex dependencies, and guide customers from discovery and solution design through deployment, transition, and adoption.

At Genesys, we are advancing customer experiences through AI-powered innovation, cloud technology, automation, and a focus on helping organizations create better interactions for their customers. This role provides exposure to strategic enterprise initiatives and senior leaders while expanding your expertise in large-scale transformation, executive stakeholder management, commercial performance, and Professional Services leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead end-to-end delivery of complex enterprise customer experience transformation projects, establishing the execution strategy, governance, success criteria, and delivery roadmap required to achieve customer and business outcomes
Direct cross-functional and geographically distributed teams across solution architecture, consulting, development, cloud and telecommunications engineering, business analysis, training, quality assurance, operations, change management, customer stakeholders, and strategic partners to maintain accountability across interconnected workstreams
Drive successful implementation and adoption of Genesys solutions from discovery and solution design through planning, execution, testing, go-live, transition to support, and value realization

Manage multiple concurrent enterprise engagements while maintaining alignment across scope, schedule, budget, quality, contractual commitments, customer satisfaction, and organizational priorities
Own project financial performance through disciplined budgeting, forecasting, revenue management, profitability and margin oversight, utilization planning, resource management, and scope governance
Optimize resource allocation across engagements to balance customer commitments, delivery capacity, utilization, and business objectives
Drive alignment among customer executives, sponsors, Genesys Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Professional Services, Support, Finance, Operations, and partner organizations to remove barriers and maintain project momentum
Lead executive steering committees, governance reviews, project kickoffs, customer workshops, and strategic planning sessions that provide actionable visibility into project health, financial performance, risks, dependencies, and decisions
Strengthen customer adoption and value realization by connecting project execution to strategic business objectives and identifying opportunities to extend value through Genesys solutions, services, and transformation initiatives

Advise customers on customer experience transformation, organizational readiness, and change management practices that support sustainable adoption of cloud, AI, automation, and modern CX capabilities

8+ years of project or program management experience leading complex enterprise technology implementations

Demonstrated success managing enterprise customer engagements across the complete project lifecycle, from planning through production, transition, and adoption
Strong background leading geographically distributed, cross-functional teams within global matrix organizations
Proven experience managing project financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, revenue, profitability, margins, utilization, and resource planning
Demonstrated executive presence and ability to communicate with, advise, negotiate with, and influence senior customer and internal stakeholders
Exceptional leadership, stakeholder management, negotiation, conflict resolution, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving capabilities
Proven ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and executive stakeholders without direct authority
Experience applying Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies to complex enterprise technology projects
Strong understanding of enterprise software implementations, cloud technologies, and customer experience platforms
Technical aptitude and business acumen to communicate effectively with both technical and executive audiences
Expertise in project governance, KPI reporting, financial management, risk management, organizational change, and process improvement
Proficiency with project and collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Project, Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Jira, Azure DevOps, and Smartsheet
Ability to travel up to 25 percent to support customer engagements and business needs

Preferred Qualifications:

PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project or program management certification
Experience implementing Genesys Cloud CX, Genesys Engage, or comparable enterprise CCaaS platforms
Experience leading cloud migration or AI-enabled customer experience transformation programs
Familiarity with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Experience supporting pre-sales consulting, solution estimation, Statements of Work, and proposal development
Knowledge of ITIL, Prosci Change Management, Lean, or Six Sigma methodologies
Experience working within enterprise Professional Services organizations supporting Fortune 1000 customers

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (AI Products)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Products) based in Brazil.

This is a hands-on Technical Project Management opportunity for a professional who can lead AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and iteration. You will combine delivery leadership with strong business analysis skills, turning complex business, clinical, and market goals into clear, actionable requirements. The role offers substantial ownership across scope, planning, stakeholder alignment, quality, governance, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineering teams and need enough technical fluency to engage confidently in architecture discussions and challenge assumptions. The environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than simply managing schedules. You will also have opportunities to introduce automation, AI tooling, and efficient processes that improve delivery quality and reduce operational overhead.

Accountabilities

Lead AI-first projects end-to-end, from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
Translate business, clinical, and market objectives into clear, actionable, and technically feasible requirements.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues while maintaining strong delivery discipline.
Coordinate standups, Scrum ceremonies, stakeholder communications, project updates, and vendor activities as required.
Develop and maintain business analysis deliverables, including epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, gap analyses, and functional documentation.
Work closely with engineering teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, understand technical architecture discussions, and remove delivery blockers.
Establish UAT plans, coordinate testing activities, prepare cutover plans and runbooks, and ensure teams are ready for production releases.
Track KPIs and OKRs, evaluate project outcomes, and use retrospective feedback to continuously improve delivery processes.
Establish project governance frameworks, including RACI structures, change-control processes, documentation standards, risk management, and privacy checklists.
Build dashboards, templates, and AI-powered automations that reduce project management overhead and improve visibility into delivery performance.
Maintain efficient task prioritization, delegation, and execution using project and collaboration tools such as ClickUp, Basecamp, Mattermost, Slack, and instant messaging.
Monitor delivery performance against agreed targets, with a strong focus on achieving projects on time and within scope.
Produce clear, concise documentation that reduces ambiguity, minimizes rework, and accelerates engineering throughput.
Act as a trusted bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, and other project participants.

Requirements

5–8+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, Project Management, and/or Business Analysis.
At least 3 years of demonstrated experience managing fast-paced projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent delivery priorities.
Proven experience delivering cloud-based or AI-enabled products or features in close collaboration with engineering teams.
Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, and gap analysis.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand architecture discussions, communicate effectively with developers, and independently structure delivery plans.
Demonstrated ability to maintain a 90%+ delivery rate within projected timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong ability to turn complex information into clear and actionable documentation.
Strong organizational skills, including prioritization, delegation, time management, and risk management.
Experience with project management and collaboration tools; familiarity with ClickUp is particularly relevant.
Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions, and maintain delivery momentum in a high-growth environment.
Strong understanding of project governance, quality management, UAT, release readiness, KPI tracking, and retrospective processes.
Experience using automation or AI tools to improve project management workflows is a plus.
Experience delivering health or clinical products, regulated-data projects, or other highly controlled environments is desirable.
Familiarity with automated KPI dashboards and AI-enabled PM workflows is an advantage.

Benefits

USD $1,000–$1,500 per month base contractor fee.
Performance incentives, including an annual bonus for KPI over-performance.
Independent contractor engagement with monthly invoicing.
Payment in USD through direct bank deposit.
Fully remote work.
Significant ownership across product discovery, delivery, and iteration.
Opportunity to work on AI-enabled products across health, wellbeing, education, and enterprise.
End-to-end exposure spanning business analysis, product strategy, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and user insights.
Opportunity to introduce AI and automation into project management and delivery processes.
Fast-growth environment with opportunities for increased responsibility as the organization scales.
Practical, impact-oriented work focused on helping teams operate more intentionally, transparently, and effectively.

How Jobgether Works

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Commercial Architectural Metal & Glass
jobs.description:
Project Manager – Lead Commercial Glazing & Metal Projects Nationwide with Mass Merchandising

Job Overview

Company: Mass Merchandising
Salary/Pay Rate: $130,000 - $150,000 base salary plus Profit Sharing and Annual Performance based Bonus
Location: Melville, New York 11747, office located in Bohemia, New York - 50% in office, 50% on jobsites (NY) - (subject to workload)
Job/Employment Type: Full Time
Project Scope: Commercial Architectural Metal and Glass
Mandatory Licenses & Certifications: OHSA30 minimum

The Opportunity

You will step into a pivotal leadership role managing multiple high-value commercial architectural metal and glass projects from pre-construction through final closeout. Joining an established company with a 67-year legacy, you will drive project success while fostering strong collaborative relationships with top architects and general contractors. This position empowers you to make a lasting structural impact on major commercial landscapes within a supportive, family-oriented corporate culture.

How You Will Make An Impact

Oversee 8 to 15 commercial architectural metal and glass projects simultaneously from initial award through final closeout.
Drive project schedules, material procurement logs, and labor allocation to ensure all phases remain on track and within budget.
Cultivate trusted, transparent relationships with general contractors, architects, and field teams through proactive and honest communication.
Manage complex financial landscapes including cost controls, forecasting, regular billings, change orders, and overall project profitability.
Coordinate seamlessly with estimating, drafting, fabrication, and installation departments to streamline material lead times and sequencing.
Resolve real-time technical hurdles and logistical conflicts on active jobsites under fast-paced, high-pressure construction conditions.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Minimum of 3 years of dedicated project management experience within the architectural metal, glazing, storefront, or curtain wall industry.
Deep technical knowledge of commercial interior and exterior glazing systems, custom metal, fabrication processes, and installation methods.
Proven ability to interpret and extract detailed data from architectural drawings, shop drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications.
Demonstrated track record of successfully managing a high volume of complex commercial construction projects at one time.
High proficiency with modern construction management technology including Procore, ACC Autodesk, Bluebeam, or equivalent software platforms.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field is preferable but not required.
7 or more years of related work experience in commercial glazing and specialty architectural metals.
Specialized expertise with storefront systems, Herculite entrances, and custom metal design & fabrication.
Active OSHA safety certification
AutoCAD knowledge helpful
Strong, established working network and direct project experience within the New York City and tri-state area construction market.

Compensation & Benefits

Company Tablet provided
Paid transportation/gas reimbursement for travel to job sites (subway/train or federal mileage rate for driving)
Weekly pay cycle structure with additional annual bonus opportunities and profit-sharing options.(Profit sharing kicks in after 2 years in company)
401(k) retirement savings program backed by a dedicated employer matching contribution. Contributions AND employer match both start 1 year after start date (first of the month following the 1-year anniversary)
Comprehensive medical insurance, dental insurance, and disability coverage (3 month waiting period)
Paid time off allowances covering scheduled company holidays, vacation days, and sick leave. PTO time grows with tenure.
Career development perks including manufacturer training, technical certifications, OSHA training, and safety equipment provisions.
Vibrant team environment featuring regular company-sponsored events and annual outings

About Us

Mass Merchandising has spent the last 67 years building an unshakeable reputation for quality work and lasting relationships in the architectural metal and glass industry. We offer the absolute stability of an established, market-tested enterprise combined with the close-knit, supportive culture of a family-owned business. Our team members take pride in having each other's backs, collaborating daily to deliver exceptional commercial environments for general contractors and architects nationwide.

jobs.description:
Description

The Leidos National Airspace Systems (NAS) Integration Contract (NISC) Support Program is looking for a senior level Program Analyst to provide executive operation support for the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Office of Government and Industry Affairs (AGI). AGI is the principal advisor to the Administrator and FAA Lines of Business/Staff Offices on all matters concerning the Congress, aviation industry groups, and other governmental organizations.

Specifically, this work provides executive level program analysis support for ASE executive leadership and senior management. The work directly supports the FAA’s safety mission and statutory requirements across multiple functional areas including safety oversight, security, and FAA Reauthorization implementation activities.

Potential for Telework: No.

Business Travel: No.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders across FAA, Department of Transportation (DOT), and other federal agencies.
Support executives and program technical actions for the FAA Administrators, management team, and staff, including logistical support, administrative briefings, and urgent action items.
Ensure work is compliant with FAA and ASE policies, orders, and guidelines, and that work products are completed timely, accurately, and within the scope of work.
Conduct in-depth research and analysis to lead and/or support FAA staff with special projects and routine tasks. Provide analytical input for management briefings and program reviews.
Compile and complete project documents, prepare required reports that highlight the major work completed by the organization, and prepare draft briefings to executive management, as required.
Directly responsible for the business operations of AGI to include full lifecycle meeting facilitation, logistical coordination for engagement sessions, and monitoring the office mailbox.
Utilize internal systems (e.g., SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, E2, Concur, or agency-specific tools) to manage workflows and communication.
Review, prepare, coordinate, and manage domestic and international travel arrangements, including processing country clearances, travel authorizations, and expense vouchers while adhering to federal travel guidance and budget parameters.
Provide full logistical support for meetings and/or teleconferences of various sizes to include preparing support materials, reserving meeting locations, taking accurate meeting minutes, following up with summary notes/minutes or reports from meetings, preparing and distributing summary notes from prior meetings to key stakeholders and meeting participants, and other duties as assigned.
Maintain office files, records, and logs—ensuring that routed document packets are accurate, signed, as well as reviewed and/or approved.
Conduct calendar maintenance and appointment scheduling for FAA executive leadership, management, and team.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors degree and 4+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 2 - 6 years of prior relevant experience. Sufficient relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
Excellent written communication skills are a must. This position requires the incumbent to proof, edit, and finalize official documents using independent discretion on completion and disbursement.
Ability to communicate to various levels of management, with the capacity to multi-task, strong organizational skills, budget adherence experience, and ability to organize meetings consisting of agency and external stakeholders with a broad range of specialties and interests including members from professional aviation organizations are required.
High proficiency in utilizing Microsoft Office applications to include Word, Excel, Teams, and PowerPoint.
Experience with editing and proofreading official documents.
Must be able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Security clearance.
Position requires in-person support five days a week, FAA or DOT Headquarters in Washington, DC. There is not a telework or remote option.

Project management of batteries refers to a series of management activities involving planning, organizing, implementing and controlling during the battery production process. Manage the planning, resource allocation, progress control, risk management, quality assurance and other aspects of battery projects. During the battery mass production stage, pay attention to and solve the construction situation of the production line, and respond to various audits and demand inquiries from customers.

Project Plan: Determine the project's goals, scope, schedule, resource requirements, etc., formulate a detailed project plan, and identify the critical path and milestones.
Resource management: Effectively allocate and schedule the human, material, financial and other resources required for the project to ensure its smooth progress.
Risk management: Identify potential risks that the project may face and formulate corresponding response strategies to reduce the impact of project risks on schedule and cost.
Progress control: Supervise the progress of the project, adjust the plan in a timely manner, and ensure the project is completed on schedule.
Quality Management: Ensure that the battery products delivered for the project meet quality standards, take corresponding quality control measures, and supervise and evaluate the project quality.
Communication Management: Establish a sound communication mechanism to ensure effective communication among project team members and with relevant stakeholders, promoting the smooth progress of the project.

Fluent bilingual capability in both Chinese and English; capable of independently drafting project documents, holding online/offline customer audit meetings and daily business communication in English.
Solid full-cycle battery project management experience, familiar with new product introduction (NPI) and mass production delivery processes of power/energy storage batteries.
Able to travel moderately as required by project and customer needs.

new_jobs.description:
About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a strategic, hands-on VCD Implementation Manager to lead the team responsible for onboarding homebuilders onto the Higharc platform. This is a leadership role for someone who builds systems, holds a high bar, and isn't satisfied with delivery that stops short of real customer adoption.

What You'll Do

You'll own the Implementation function end-to-end — managing a team of Implementation Leads and Specialists, setting the standard for how implementations run, and making sure customer onboarding consistently delivers measurable value. You're not just keeping projects on track; you're challenging how the work gets done and building the infrastructure for the team to scale without adding headcount every time volume increases.

A big part of this role is operational clarity. You'll create the reporting and dashboards that surface where work is flowing and where it's stuck, then act on what you see. You'll push your team toward standardization — fewer one-off approaches, more templates and repeatable systems that preserve quality at scale. When something goes sideways with a customer, you step in.

You'll also work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales — translating implementation learnings into product feedback and coordinating across teams to solve problems that don't stay in one lane.

Expect to:

Own planning, scoping, and resourcing across active customer implementations
Manage and coach a team of Implementation Leads and Specialists, with clear goals and accountability to results
Build and maintain reporting on plan throughput, QA/QC ratings, milestone achievement, and team capacity
Identify inefficiencies in how the team works and drive adoption of better, more standardized approaches
Serve as the escalation owner when customer implementations are at risk — and see them through to resolution
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Sales to surface learnings and improve execution
Travel up to 20% for customer on-sites and company retreats

About You

You're a leader who gets things done through clarity, not just effort. You've managed implementation or project teams in complex environments and you know that true success isn't plan delivery — it's adoption. You set high expectations for your team and for yourself, and you're willing to get into the details when that's what it takes to clear a blocker.

You thrive when there's ambiguity to structure. You don't wait to be handed a playbook — you build one, test it, and improve it. You're as comfortable presenting to leadership as you are working through a thorny process problem with your team. And you have enough technical depth in BIM and construction workflows to earn credibility with the people you manage and the builders you serve.

You have:

5+ years using BIM software and/or leading implementation or project teams in tech, construction, or homebuilding software
Proven experience managing people and running complex, fast-moving customer onboarding projects
A track record of building and using team performance metrics — throughput, quality, efficiency — to drive real improvement
Hands-on knowledge of CAD/BIM tools (Revit, AutoCAD, or similar) and homebuilding or construction workflows
Strong instincts for spotting inefficiency and the follow-through to actually fix it
A bias toward action and a willingness to challenge how things have always been done
Clear, confident communication style with high expectations — for your team and yourself

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel:
Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and
asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits:
Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Stripe’s mission is to build the economic infrastructure for the internet. Risk and Compliance Engineering builds products to lower Stripe’s financial and regulatory risk at scale, while retaining a best in class user experience. We build user-facing products, and backend platforms to ensure Stripe’s users are compliant with regulatory and financial partner requirements. We protect Stripe’s brand while also protecting the company from financial losses that can put Stripe’s business at risk. The Risk TPM team is crucial to driving programs to address these challenges.

What you’ll do

As a Technical Program Manager in the Risk and Compliance space, you will play a key role across engineering, product, and strategy to drive programs that span across the Risk organization and Stripe. You will be responsible for the successful definition, cross-functional strategy, planning and execution of large-scale technical programs that help to solve complex problems and empower Stripe and our users.

Responsibilities

Execute on technical programs that require deep systems and engineering knowledge.
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers and other cross functional partners to define, scope, and drive large programs to conclusion.
Develop, implement, and iterate on program management techniques, frameworks, and KPIs to achieve goals with well defined success criteria.
Make substantial improvements to how the teams you work with communicate and operate to significantly increase the productivity and efficiency of the teams.
Define and produce high quality written proposals, communications and documentation.
Leverage data and acquired knowledge to drive strategic decisions at an engineering leadership level.
Create widely circulated plans, driving consistency, clarity and building alignment across teams.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of software engineering, systems engineering and/or technical program management experience.
Excellent analytical skills; you digest complex information and make recommendations.
You have a track record of providing program management during all phases of software development from kick-off to launch, demonstrating critical thinking, challenging the norms and thought leadership.
You have very strong written and verbal communication skills, building strong relationships with stakeholders, teams and senior leaders around the organization.
You can drive internal and external process improvements across multiple teams and functions and bring a wealth of experience, opinions, proposals and best practices.
Experience operating autonomously and leading large-scale efforts across multiple teams and functions, with stakeholders in different disciplines across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in financial risk and compliance
SQL and python scripting and/or programming skills

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
ComPsych Ⓡ is the worldwide leader in organizational mental health, well-being, and absence management, dedicated to igniting human potential in workplaces across the globe. For over 40 years, we have combined the best in technology with unmatched human expertise to help individuals and their organizations thrive. Our GuidanceResources Ⓡ and AbsenceResources Ⓡ solutions deliver end-to-end mental health, well-being, work-life, health navigation, and absence support to more than 75,000 customers worldwide, touching more than 160 million lives across 200 countries. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health and absence management needs.

Job Summary

Program management at ComPsych is an enablement function: the job is to make it easier for teams to deliver value by removing friction in people, process, technology, and tools; naming problems plainly and owning them toward resolution rather than escalating them away; and defending the processes that help teams work well while killing the ones that don't. The Program Manager, Technology is one of three leadership roles accountable for a product development group, alongside a product leader who owns what gets built and why, and an engineering leader who owns how it gets built and the health of the systems underneath it. This role owns how the work flows — and, paradoxically, its effectiveness is measured by how much less the teams need it over time. AI is a fundamental part of how ComPsych works, and this role is expected to embrace and help lead the evolution of agile structures, processes, and ways of working as AI changes the constraints on delivery.

Primary Responsibilities

Run multi-team planning: convert roadmap intent into a sequenced, capacity-aware view of what the group can commit to and what it cannot, and re-plan early, with options attached, when reality diverges.
Own the group's operating rhythm: the cadence of planning, review, demonstration, and retrospective that keeps sub-teams synchronized, ensuring every recurring ceremony answers ‘what decision does this enable?’
Hunt friction and delay: find the handoffs, queues, approval bottlenecks, and environment delays slowing the group, and lead the work that removes them.
Drive dependencies to resolution inside the group and across its neighbors, bringing a proposed path forward with every risk raised rather than only cataloging risks.
Make trade-offs explicit — what is gained, what is given up, and what it costs to defer — then drive them to a decision, saying no or not yet to work that doesn't fit the priorities, backed by data.
Coach the teams continuously on story decomposition, vertical slicing, estimation, Definition of Ready and Done, retrospective quality, and WIP discipline, teaching the reasoning behind a practice rather than the ceremony, and developing the Scrum Masters and delivery leads around them.
Make retrospectives produce change, owning that at least one improvement per cycle is tracked to closure.
Measure flow and outcomes rather than activity, discontinuing any metric that doesn't change a decision.
Orchestrate go-to-market for the group's launches, owning the release calendar and gates and keeping delivery and commercial tracks — marketing, sales, customer success, partner enablement, legal and privacy, clinical and compliance, implementation, and support — moving in parallel from prioritization forward.
Embrace change and enable AI workflows, helping lead the discovery of new ways of working as AI reshapes agile structures, processes, metrics, and ceremonies.
Other duties as assigned

Job Qualifications

Education: No specific degree required ; demonstrated practice is valued over credentials.
Self-starter with ability to multi-task and work autonomously
Excellent organizational and project management skills
Effective interpersonal and communication skills
10+ years of experience in program, delivery, or technical project management, including at least 7 years in software product development, with a track record of orchestrating delivery across multiple teams toward a shared outcome and accountability for results across teams not directly managed.
Demonstrated ability to operate as a peer to product and engineering leadership rather than as a reporting function — driving alignment through sound reasoning and visible trade-offs.
Systems-level thinking: ability to name upstream demand, downstream consumers, and the current bottleneck, and to target improvement work at the bottleneck rather than the loudest complaint.
Fluency with flow metrics — cycle time, work in progress, throughput, blocked and wait time, predictability, deployment frequency — and a track record of using data to change how the system works, not just to narrate status.
Experience carrying launches, not just releases, including coordinating cross-functional go-to-market readiness alongside software delivery and piloted or staged rollouts.
Comfort holding multiple plausible scenarios open under ambiguity, committing decisively once evidence supports a direction, and changing course when the evidence says to.
A coaching orientation: ability to teach the reasoning behind a practice rather than police the ritual, and to read teams accurately enough to know what each needs next.
Also valuable, though not required: experience as a Release Train Engineer, Solution Train Engineer, delivery lead, or Agile coach ( SAFe or non- SAFe ); experience supporting a long-lived product group rather than a series of discrete projects; experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or other regulated environments; experience helping an organization move from project-based delivery to flow-based ways of working; and experience building DORA and SPACE metrics in Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms. Certifications are welcome but not required .
FLSA Exemption Basis
This role is classified as exempt under the administrative exemption. The Program Manager's primary duty is the performance of office work directly related to the management and general business operations of ComPsych, and includes the exercise of discretion and independent judgment with respect to matters of significance, including multi-team planning, prioritization trade-offs, dependency resolution, and go-to-market sequencing. The role operates as a peer to product and engineering leadership rather than in a reporting capacity to them. Exemption status should be confirmed periodically against then-current federal and state wage and hour law.

Other Requirements

Ability to be present on camera during work-related trainings , meetings, and/or events
Must be able to sit or stand at a desk for prolonged periods while working on a computer

About Impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands - including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics - rely on impact.com to power more than 350,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at
impact.com
:

As impact.com continues to scale its global partnership management platform, our product offering and distributed system architectures grow increasingly interconnected. Delivering major, high-leverage software capabilities is no longer the work of single, isolated squads; instead, it demands seamless coordination, dependency management, and flawless alignment across multiple engineering, product, design, and data science teams.

Without dedicated operational guidance, complex cross-functional initiatives face risks of misalignment, fragmented tracking, delayed releases, and administrative overhead on engineering leadership.

The Technical Project Manager (TPM)
role is established within the Product Operations sub-department to resolve these challenges. By serving as the operational connective tissue across squads, the TPM ensures that multi-team technical programs are planned with rigor, executed with agility, and delivered with predictability. This role is essential for accelerating program velocity, resolving structural friction points, and keeping our R&D teams highly aligned with overall business outcomes and customer success.

The Technical Project Manager is a dynamic, highly visible execution leader within impact.com's Product & Technology division. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Product Operations, this individual takes end-to-end operational ownership of cross-functional technical programs from inception to post-launch evaluation.

The TPM is a "player-coach" of process and program execution. They act as a trusted partner to engineering managers, product leads, and UX designers, using Agile and Scrum methodologies to keep highly complex, multi-team efforts on track.

This role requires a unique combination of sharp organizational instincts, deep communication skills, and technical credibility—allowing you to engage deeply with engineers on architecture, APIs, and system dependencies. Additionally, this role champions modern operations by actively leveraging generative AI tools to maximize personal productivity, streamline documentation, and continuously mature the wider TPM playbook.

What You'll Do:

Program & Delivery Management (40%)
End-to-End Delivery: Own the execution of complex, multi-team technical programs, ensuring they progress predictably from early scoping and dependency mapping through launch and stabilization.
Agile Orchestration: Drive agile program ceremonies, coordinate cross-squad sprint reviews, organize program-level syncs, and facilitate joint retrospectives.
Tracking & Documentation: Establish and maintain high hygiene standards for project tracking in Jira (boards, epics, sprint mapping, and active dependency links) and structured, accessible documentation in Confluence.
Risk & Blocker Mitigation: Proactively identify, track, and resolve scope creep, resource constraints, technical blockers, and team-to-team dependencies before they impact the critical path.
SLA & Reporting: Define program milestones, establish success metrics, and own the communication of progress, health, and risk profiles to R&D and business leadership.
Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment (30%)
Connective Tissue: Serve as the primary operational link bridging Engineering, Product, Design, Data, and go-to-market/customer-facing business teams.
Communication Governance: Author and execute comprehensive stakeholder communication plans, ensuring alignment on project changes, escalation paths, and key decision logs.
Trade-off Facilitation: Host and guide trade-off discussions when squads face conflicting priorities, resource constraints, or architectural friction points, presenting structured, data-driven options to leaders.
Resource Balance: Collaborate with engineering managers and product leads to ensure sprint commitments sensibly balance new feature delivery, tech debt reduction, and operational support.
Process Maturity & Continuous Improvement (20%)
Agile Enablement: Coach and support engineering squads of varying maturity levels, helping them refine their local Scrum/Kanban practices to improve flow and cycle time.
Objective Post-Mortems: Run blame-free retrospectives and post-mortems following major releases or system-layer issues, translating takeaways into immediate process updates.
TPM Practice Development: Actively contribute to building the internal TPM practice by developing shared templates, delivery playbooks, and standardized metric dashboards.
Technical Literacy & Modern AI Productivity (10%)
AI-Powered Workflows: Actively utilize modern generative AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or Copilot) to accelerate daily tasks—such as synthesizing documentation, drafting clear stakeholder communications, and automating administrative program tracking.
Technical Engagement: Build a strong working knowledge of impact.com's system architectures, APIs, and cloud infrastructure patterns to credibly challenge timelines, identify technical risks, and participate in scoping discussions with technical leads.

Owned KPIs and Outcomes

North Stars

Cross-functional programs are delivered predictably, on scope, and with high transparency across R&D and GTM teams.
Multi-team dependencies are identified and resolved proactively, minimizing critical-path slippage and structural friction.

Program & Delivery Metrics

Milestone Predictability: Achievement rate of critical program milestones and target launch windows.
Time-to-Resolution for Blockers: Speed and effectiveness of clearing cross-team blockers and resource constraints.
Stakeholder Sentiment: Positive alignment and communication satisfaction scores from collaborating squads and product partners.

Operational & Hygiene Metrics

Jira & Confluence Health: Accuracy and completeness of epic definitions, dependency linkages, active decision logs, and release plans.
Retrospective Action Rate: The speed at which retro-identified improvement items are actioned and implemented in future sprints.
Cycle Time reduction: Measurable improvement in delivery velocity for multi-squad initiatives through refined dependency planning.

What You Bring:

Minimum Qualifications:

Experience: 5+ years of dedicated technical project or program management experience within a fast-paced software development or technology environment.
Program Execution: Proven track record of successfully guiding complex, multi-team programs with interdependencies from initiation to global launch.
Agile Mastery: Deep command of Agile/Scrum methodologies, with the practical ability to adapt frameworks to fit squad-specific maturity and organizational contexts.
Tooling Expertise: Advanced hands-on experience utilizing Jira (roadmaps, cross-team boards, reporting) and Confluence to manage complex documentation.
Technical Literacy: Ability to understand technical architectures, API integrations, and system infrastructure well enough to engage credibly with staff engineers and architects.
AI Tool Integration: Demonstrated experience using AI productivity tools (e.g., Cursor, Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate personal output, draft communications, or synthesize technical data.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical states into concise, clear updates for executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent professional project management credentials.
Advanced Technology Exposure: Familiarity with LLM-based product workflows, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or model fine-tuning processes.

At Agility Robotics, we are building a future where robots work alongside people to make life better. Our Transmission Planning and Power Systems Analysis team works with a diverse mix of clients—investor-owned utilities, public power entities, developers, and ISOs/RTOs—to deliver smart, resilient, and future-ready electric grid solutions. Are you ready to help drive the energy transition forward?

As a Transmission Planning Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing all phases of transmission planning projects, from business development through execution. You will manage multidisciplinary teams, develop scope and fee structures, ensure quality deliverables, and maintain strong client relationships. You’ll also be a mentor and resource for growing talent within our team. Key responsibilities include:

Business Development

Cultivate and grow client relationships through marketing efforts, project interactions, and strategic engagement.

Lead proposal development, project scoping, budgeting, and scheduling activities.
Set critical project objectives with clients and lead contract development and negotiations.

Project Execution

Manage the full lifecycle of transmission planning projects including scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client communication.

Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary project teams of engineers and analysts.
Communicate project status, risks, and costs to stakeholders and executive leadership.

Champion internal initiatives that promote team growth and technical excellence.
Serve as a go-to technical expert in transmission system planning and evaluation.

Brief Job Description

The Texas Health and Specialty Care System (HSCS) is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Data Analyst to join the Office of Forensic Services and Coordination (OFSC). In this essential role, the Data Analyst will support and enhance data reporting, analytics, and operational processes across the forensic service continuum. The position is responsible for maintaining and improving existing reporting products, identifying opportunities to automate workflows, optimizing data extraction and reporting processes, and supporting data-informed decision-making through analysis and visualization of complex datasets.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong foundation in data analytics, reporting, and statistical analysis, with experience working with large datasets and developing solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and accessibility of information. This position will work closely with program staff, leadership, and data partners to support ongoing reporting needs, improve data quality, and identify innovative approaches to strengthen business processes and reporting capabilities. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, effective collaboration, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development in emerging data tools and technologies.

The Data Analyst works under the direction of OFSC’s data analyst on the policy, planning, research and coordination team within the OFSC with moderate latitude for the use of initiative and independent judgement to ensure the statutorily mandated duties of the Forensic Director (SB 1507, 84th Legislature, Regular Session, 2015) are met. These duties include statewide coordination and oversight of forensic services; coordination of forensic programs operated by HHSC; and addressing issues with the delivery of forensic services in Texas including significant increases in populations with serious mental illness and criminal justice system involvement. The Data Analyst will be expected to be a motivated self-starter.

The salary will be offered in accordance with the salary range posted for this position. Salary requests outside of the range in the posting will not be considered and is non-negotiable. For internal applicants, salary negotiations must align with the HHS Human Resources Manual and align with the salary range for this posting. For internal applicants, salary requests beyond the salary range in this posting or that require higher level approvals will not be considered.

Essential Job Functions (EJFs)

Data Analysis Reporting and Dashboard Support: Maintains, enhances, and supports reporting products, dashboards, and analytical tools used across the forensic service continuum. Performs analysis of complex datasets to identify operational trends, performance measures, and outcomes. Creates reports, visualizations, and data summaries that support business operations and data-informed decision-making. Assists in translating technical findings into understandable information for leadership and program staff.

(25%)

Data Automation and Process Improvement: Identifies opportunities to automate recurring reports, data collection activities, and business processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort. Develops and improves automated workflows, data refresh processes, validation routines, and reporting solutions. Collaborates with team members to streamline existing processes and implement sustainable, scalable data solutions. (20%)

Query Development and Data Management: Develops, maintains, and optimizes SQL queries, datasets, and reporting logic supporting forensic programs. Reviews and improves existing queries and processes to enhance performance, accuracy, and reliability. Assists with documenting data definitions, business rules, and reporting methodologies to ensure consistency and sustainability of reporting products. (15%)

Fielding Data Requests: Supports internal and external data requests by gathering requirements, conducting analyses, and delivering accurate and timely information. Works closely with HSCS leadership and staff to understand business needs and develop appropriate reporting solutions. Ensures all activities comply with applicable confidentiality, privacy, and data security requirements. (15%)

Collaboration and Data Quality Improvement: Collaborates with data partners across HSCS, Behavioral Health Services, state hospitals, state supported living centers, and other stakeholders to improve data quality, consistency, and reporting capabilities. Assists in identifying data discrepancies, conducting validation activities, and developing recommendations for process improvements that strengthen data integrity and program outcomes. (10%)

Policy Research and Evaluation: Support the development of studies, policy research, and evaluations. Partner with agency leadership and staff, universities, and stakeholders to support research and evaluation projects. (5%)

Training, Documentation, and Knowledge Sharing: Develops and maintains documentation related to reports, datasets, processes, and reporting tools. Assists in training staff on reporting products and data resources. Shares knowledge and best practices to promote effective use of data across the organization. (5%)

Continuous Professional Development: Stay current with advancements in data analytics, forensic policy, and relevant legislation. Participate in professional development opportunities, conferences, and training sessions to enhance skills and knowledge. Share insights and best practices with colleagues to foster a culture of continuous improvement within the OFSC. (5%)

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of data analytics principles, statistical concepts, and techniques used to analyze, interpret, and communicate findings from complex datasets.

Knowledge of relational databases, data models, database design concepts, and data governance practices.

Experience using SQL, Tableau, Excel, or similar business intelligence and reporting tools to develop reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.

Experience working with healthcare, behavioral health, forensic mental health services, electronic health records, or other large operational data systems.

Skill in developing, maintaining, and optimizing SQL queries, data extracts, and reporting processes.

Skill in analyzing problems, identifying opportunities for process improvement, and developing effective data-driven solutions.

Ability to compile, review, validate, and analyze data while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and data integrity.

Ability to prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, and data visualizations and communicate technical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Ability and willingness to learn emerging technologies, automation tools, and advanced analytics techniques to enhance reporting capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.

High degree of integrity, ability to build trust and communicate effectively.

Ability to work the hours of 8 a.m.-5 p.m., Monday through Friday with flexibility to be available after hours as needed such as during Legislative Sessions.

Registrations, Licensure Requirements Or Certifications

N/A

Initial Screening Criteria

A bachelors, masters degree or doctoral degree from an accredited university in one of the following disciplines: data science, computer science, business administration, business analytics, public administration, information technology or mathematics. Other disciplines will be considered based on relevant coursework and experience.

Demonstrated experience in data analytics and research, with expertise in statistical modeling to identify patterns and trends in existing datasets.

Experience in managing complex datasets.
