About Impact.com

impact.com is the world’s leading commerce partnership marketing platform, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey. From affiliates and influencers to content publishers, brand ambassadors, and customer advocates, impact.com empowers brands to drive trusted, performance-based growth through authentic relationships. Its award-winning products— Performance
(affiliate), Creator
(influencer), and Advocate
(customer referral)—unify every type of partner into one integrated platform. As consumers increasingly rely on recommendations from people and communities they trust, impact.com helps brands show up where it matters most. Today, over 5,000 global brands, including Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, L’Oréal, and Fanatics, rely on impact.com to power more than 225,000 partnerships that deliver measurable business results.

Your Role at Impact:

The Associate Data Analyst is responsible for collecting, analyzing and interpreting large and complex datasets to identify patterns and trends, surfacing facts and assist in developing insights and providing data-driven outputs and recommendations to support business decisions. The ideal candidate will have a keen interest in and some prior experience of data analysis, reporting and forecasting. The associate data analyst needs to be a clear communicator that can confidently interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The Associate Data Analyst will form part of and actively participate in the data analytics competency, with special focus on building data and reporting outputs as directed by senior team members. The analyst will be a contributing member of the analytics center of excellence (ACoE) and adopt best practices as outlined by ACoE leadership.

What You'll Do:

Extract and analyze data from various sources including relational databases (mySQL, postgres), big data technologies (BigQuery, Kudu, Impala, SingleStore, Hive), file sources (parquet, ORC, avro, csv, xlsx) and reporting systems (Looker, DOMO).
Assist with the identification, creation and maintenance of master datasets.
Participate in data stewardship initiatives.
Clean and manipulate data to ensure high quality and integrity of reporting outputs.
Contribute to technical specifications for new data assets (marts, tables, views, cubes).
Analyze source systems and help identify business logic embedded in the underlying datasets.
Use statistical techniques to identify trends and derive patterns and insights embedded in the data.
Identify and communicate data quality and data validation issues in productionalized datasets.
Create visualizations and dashboards as directed by the squad lead and required by business stakeholders.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports to support business stakeholders.
Perform ad-hoc data analysis to determine suitability of a data source for use in data marts and reporting outputs or to assess key performance indicators (KPIs).
Communicate findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical team members in a clear and concise manner.

What You Have:

Preferred Requirements:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Experience: 2+ years of experience in a data analysis, business intelligence, or data engineering role.
Core Technical Skills: * Strong Python and SQL coding skills.
Demonstrable data analysis and data visualization skills.
Hands-on exposure to data wrangling (data cleaning, manipulation, and preparation).
Tools & Platforms: * Exposure to the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its integrated technologies.
Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, SSRS/SSAS, or QlikView.
Professional & Soft Skills:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Nice to Have (Advantageous) Requirements:

Advanced Data Stack: Deep exposure to DataBricks, PySpark, and BigQuery.
Data Systems: Exposure to NoSQL data systems and streaming platforms (HBase, Redis, Kafka).
Data Science: Exposure to machine learning libraries, tools, and protocols (both supervised & unsupervised learning).
Statistical Depth: Exposure to standard statistical modeling and forecasting methodologies.
Domain Expertise: Prior experience working within the Marketing Technology (MarTech) industry.

Benefits and Perks:

At impact.com, we believe that when you’re happy and fulfilled, you do your best work. That’s why we’ve built a benefits package that supports your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

Flexible Working: Our Responsible PTO policy means you can take the time off you need to rest and recharge. We're committed to a positive work-life balance and provide a flexible environment that allows you to be happy and fulfilled in both your career and your personal life.
Health and Wellness: Your well-being is a priority. Our mental health and wellness benefit includes up to 12 fully covered therapy/coaching sessions per year, with additional dependent coverage. We also offer a monthly gym reimbursement policy to support your physical health.
A Stake in Our Growth: We offer Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) as part of our total compensation, giving you a stake in the company's growth with a 3-year vesting schedule, pending Board approval.
Investing in Your Growth: We’re committed to your continuous learning. Take advantage of our free Coursera subscription and our PXA courses.
Parental Support: We offer a generous parental leave policy, 26 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 13 weeks fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver.

Job Requisition ID: 87099

The Alberta Public Service works to build a stronger province for current and future generations. We make a difference in the lives of Albertans through rewarding and diverse career opportunities.

The System Support and Policy Branch provides leadership to build system capacity to meet the needs of children and youth through cross-ministry and welcoming, caring, respectful and safe learning environment initiatives. This role analyzes programs and builds system capacity that promotes an inclusive education system for children and students.

For more information about the Ministry of Education and Childcare, please visit https://www.alberta.ca/education-and-childcare

Role Responsibilities

Reporting to the Safe Learning Environment Manager, the Strategic Initiatives and Research Analyst is central to building the education system’s capacity to meet the social, emotional and mental health needs of children and youth, supporting their success and well-being in school.

This position provides strategic and research services on a range of complex issues, contributing to the development and implementation of cross-ministry strategic frameworks and operational plans. The Analyst conducts research, analyzes diverse information sources, identifies trends, capacity issues, gaps and opportunities, and develops briefings and recommendations to support operational and strategic decision-making for the branch, sector and department.

The Responsibilities For The Analyst Position Are As Below

Support cross-ministry frameworks and operational plans: Contribute to the development, implementation and evaluation of strategic frameworks and operational plans that support student well-being and safe learning environments.
Coordinate partner engagement: Liaise with ministry and cross-ministry partners, coordinate meetings and consultations, and support collaboration with government and non-government stakeholders.
Analyze policy, supports and services: Review education-related policies, programs, supports and services to identify gaps, assess implications and recommend practical solutions.
Develop recommendations and briefing materials: Prepare recommendations, briefing notes, supporting documents, speaking notes and responses to public inquiries for ministry decision-makers.
Conduct research and environmental scans: Complete literature reviews, environmental scans and research activities to identify emerging trends, issues and opportunities affecting children, youth and school authorities.
Analyze data and information: Collect, interpret and evaluate qualitative and quantitative information from internal and external sources to inform planning and decision-making.
Support accountability and evaluation: Develop performance indicators, evaluation measures and accountability approaches to assess initiatives, programs and resources.
Build school authority capacity: Plan, write, design and edit resources, reports, web content, promotional materials and presentations that help school authorities create welcoming, caring, respectful and safe learning environments.
Maintain key messaging and communications: Align messaging with current research, legislation, policy, ministry priorities and cross-ministry goals while supporting communication planning and activities.
Participate in committees and working groups: Represent branch and sector perspectives on ministry and cross-ministry committees, teams and working groups to support coordinated action and implementation of decisions.
Support continuous improvement and collaboration: Work with branch and sector colleagues to coordinate activities, improve processes, share information and ensure continuity of supports for cross-ministry priorities and initiatives.

The Job Description is provided for further details on this position.

APS Competencies

Competencies are behaviors that are essential to reach our goals in serving Albertans. We encourage you to have an in depth understanding of the competencies that are required for this opportunity and to be prepared to demonstrate them during the recruitment process.

Systems Thinking: Considers interrelationships, emerging trends and broader implications when developing research-informed recommendations that support cross-ministry priorities and student well-being.
Creative Problem Solving: Uses research, data and diverse perspectives to analyze complex issues, identify gaps and develop practical options to improve programs, initiatives and resources.
Agility: Adapts to changing priorities, stakeholder dynamics and politically sensitive issues while maintaining focus on goals, timelines and effective implementation.
Develop Networks: Builds and maintains effective relationships with branch, sector, ministry, cross-ministry and external partners to support collaboration, information sharing and coordinated action.
Drive for Results: Plans, prioritizes and collaborates with others to deliver high-quality analysis, resources, briefings and recommendations within tight and concurrent timelines.

Qualifications

University graduation in a related field plus 2 years progressively responsible related experience; or equivalent as described below.

Equivalency

Directly related education or experience considered on the basis of:

 1 year of education for 1 year of experience; or

 1 year of experience for 1 year of education.

Required Skills

Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to synthesize information from varied sources and develop sound recommendations.
Research and evaluation skills, including experience with literature reviews, environmental scans, data collection, and qualitative and quantitative analysis.
Ability to interpret policies, programs, supports and services to identify gaps, implications, options and practical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare briefings, reports, resources, presentations and other materials for varied audiences.
Experience using data management, business productivity or ministry information systems such as Microsoft Office, PASI, SADS, BI Central or dashboards.
Time management and Project Management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing assignments and meet tight, concurrent timelines.

Assets

Knowledge of the Ministry of Education and Childcare mandate, business plan, organizational structure, priorities and programs.
Knowledge of provincial education legislation, standards, ministerial orders, policies and related frameworks that guide inclusive education and student success.
Experience supporting cross-ministry initiatives, committees, working groups, strategic frameworks or operational plans.
Experience developing communications products such as web content, promotional materials, graphics, tables, charts or presentation materials.

Minimum recruitment standards outline the minimum education and experience required for appointment to a job classification.

Notes

This is one temporary position for one year, full-time position working 36.25 hours per week, Monday to Friday, in office.

This position is based in Edmonton. We require you to attach a Cover Letter and Resume with your application explaining your qualification and suitability for this role.

Candidates are required to apply online. Please see J ob Application Resources for more information.

In your resume, please include dates (including months and years) associated with all education and work experience. For example, January 2006 - June 2009 (part-time). This example is provided for illustrative purposes only. Applicants are encouraged to present their information clearly and thoroughly, using a format that best conveys their experience.

new_jobs.title: Senior Credit Strategy Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Mikinok Enterprises has revolutionized the emergency loan market by using sophisticated machine learning (artificial intelligence) and big data to detect fraud and predict payback.
We’re looking for a Senior Credit Strategy Analyst to drive credit strategies for Mikinok’s subprime consumer lending portfolio. This role is critical to balancing growth, profitability, and losses in a fast-moving environment. You’ll lead strategy development projects from marketing and underwriting through collections and recovery. This is a high-autonomy, high-ownership role where you'll design experiments, build analytical frameworks that drive multi-million-dollar decisions, and see your work move from hypothesis to production in weeks, not quarters.
You’ll partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, Project Management, and Operations teams to translate insight into scalable credit strategies that materially impact portfolio performance

In this role, you will...

Design, implement, and optimize strategies spanning recovery, underwriting, model monitoring, fraud, loan sizing/terms, and — especially — marketing, where disciplined segmentation and treatment testing directly move the bottom line
Own policy development and changes including testing, rollout, and post-implementation monitoring
Analyze portfolio performance using SQL/Python and BI to OLS to identify trends, risks, and opportunities within key metrics
Cost for new account originated
Default rates, Delinquency rates
Loss rates and unit economics
Repeat behavior and churn
Recommend proactive strategy adjustments based on identified emerging risks and upsides.
Build and evaluate test-and-learn experiments (A/B tests, DOE) across the customer life-cycle by isolating causal drivers of loss, delinquency, and recovery rates to control downside risk
Partner with Data Science on model development, performance assessments, and model-strategy alignment across customer life-cycle
Translate technical findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership and present at company-wide quarterly business reviews (QBR)
Mentor junior analysts and help establish best practice in data analytics for credit team

Requirements
Mandatory Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in an analytical/quantitative field (Math, Physics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science) from a competitive school.
Elite quantitative & analytical skills. Proven ability to drive analytical projects and insights (3+ years experience)
Strong proficiency in SQL and/or experience using Python for analysis (3+ years)
Experience using advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets analytics tools (spreadsheet formulas, pivot tables, statistical add-ins, VBA, data management and merging tools) (2+ years)
Demonstrated experience in analyzing data to draw business-relevant conclusions and in data visualization techniques and tools.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment
Strong interpersonal, leadership, and communication skills

Please Note: We are interested in every qualified candidate who is authorized to work for ANY employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Desired Qualifications

Advanced degree in an analytical/quantitative field (Math, Physics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science) from a competitive school.
5+ years of experience in complex, data-driven problem solving ideally within financial services or consulting or credit bureau
Hands-on experience with credit bureau, alternative data, lead generation, and behavioral performance data
Deep understanding of sub-prime credit dynamics including volatility, adverse selection, and risk layering
Exposure to marketing strategy or optimization

Benefits

The opportunity to help bring much-needed income and economic development to the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians
Competitive salary and bonus structure
Generous employee benefits plan, including robust healthcare plans, matching 401K, and four weeks of PTO
Company-sponsored professional development and training opportunities

About the Company

Mikinok Enterprises (d/b/a Spotloan) is a leading online direct lender founded in 2012 that utilizes advanced underwriting technology to provide short-term loans to Americans in need. Mikinok is wholly owned and operated by the Turtle Mountain Band of Chippewa Indians of North Dakota, a Federally-recognized Native American Tribe (the “Tribe”).

Mikinok Enterprises is an integral part of the Tribe’s economic development efforts, and it is an essential provider of employment opportunities on the Tribe’s reservation. Employment decisions at Mikinok are based on qualifications, ability, and merit. When qualifications are equal, candidates who are enrolled members of the Tribe will receive preference. After considering this preference, it is Mikinok’s policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all qualified persons without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national origin.

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Finance Systems & Compliance
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to lead the systems, data, and process work behind how we bill, recognize revenue, close the books, and prove our controls work.

You won't be writing the code or drawing the architecture; you'll be deciding what gets built, in what order, and why it matters. This is a role for someone who wants to understand a business well enough to change how it runs: learning the objectives, processes, and system flows end to end, then shaping them into strategic technical programs with real owners, deliberate sequencing, and decisions that hold up under audit. You'll sit between Finance and Accounting on one side and Engineering, Data, and Product on the other, and you'll be accountable for making new revenue streams operable and auditable, from a pricing model on a slide to a billed invoice, a booked journal entry, and a control that passes testing.

You'll report to the Lead Technical Program Manager for Data, Biztech & AI Transformation, within EPD. You'll get high-level direction and clear priorities from your manager, and independent ownership of how the work actually gets delivered. You'll bring engineering-side rigor and platform thinking to finance problems, and work as part of a team modernizing how the whole company operates.

Most of your time will go to three things: making new product and pricing launches work end to end in the finance stack, running the platforms and data flows behind quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and driving the IT general controls (ITGC) program so controls are designed into systems up front rather than retrofitted after go-live.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve

Act as Finance's technical counterpart on new product, pricing, and packaging launches, translating commercial models into requirements across order capture, rating and billing, tax, revenue recognition, and downstream reporting, and defining what "revenue-ready" means before go/no-go: who owns each piece, what's actually done versus asserted, and which risks are still cheap to fix
Broker the trade-off when a launch date and systems reality don't line up: a scoped manual workaround with an owner, a cost, and an expiration date, plus the path to the automated version. Then close the loop after launch on billing accuracy, exception rates, where revenue landed, whether the new controls actually operate, and what must be true to do this again at 10x volume
Independently own delivery and multi-quarter roadmaps for your finance systems programs, including ERP, billing and subscription management, CPQ, revenue subledger, procurement, and the reporting layer on top. Run the working groups that deliver them across Finance, Accounting, Engineering, Data, and Security, with clear accountability and updates leadership can read in two minutes
Run the operating rhythm: intake and prioritization, decision logs, early risk escalation, and a small set of metrics that show whether the work is actually improving anything, and flag early when committed scope and capacity don't line up
Map current-state processes and data lineage end to end and go after the breaks: reconciliation gaps, recurring manual journal entries, spreadsheets doing load-bearing work, competing sources of truth for the same metric. Partner with Data Engineering on the definitions and data contracts that let finance metrics tie cleanly to source systems, and hold the line when teams drift
Drive ITGC workstreams across in-scope financial systems: logical access and segregation of duties, change management, SDLC and CI/CD pipelines, job scheduling, and data interfaces. Partner with Internal Audit on scoping and control design, with a named owner for every control
Facilitate designing controls into new systems, systems changes, and launches before go-live with Controllership, Internal Audit, and Engineering, and serve as the systems-side point of contact for internal and external audit on ITGC walkthroughs and testing, translating between control language and engineering language, and driving deficiencies through root cause, named owners, evidence, and validation that the fix holds
Build AI-assisted workflows that expand what the teams around you can cover, and hold them to real standards: a defined task, a way to evaluate output quality, explicit human review gates on anything touching financial reporting, and documentation so someone else can run it

Skills You'll Need To Bring

5+ years in technical program management, business systems, finance transformation, or a related field, with substantial time on finance or revenue systems; public-company or IPO-track experience is a strong plus
Working fluency in finance operations; you don't need to be an accountant, but you should hold your own on quote-to-cash and record-to-report, and know why revenue recognition is not the same as billing
Hands-on ITGC program experience across access, change management, and IT operations for in-scope financial systems, plus practical SOX knowledge. You understand how ITGC reliance determines what auditors will accept from automated controls and system-generated reports, can tell a key control from a non-key one, know where ITACs fit alongside ITGCs, and have been through remediation and audit cycles rather than only reading about them
AI-native operating mindset; this is a core requirement for this role. You already use AI to draft requirements, synthesize status, triage intake, and assemble evidence packages, and you share the patterns so others work differently because of what you built
A track record of independently delivering technical programs end to end, ideally transformation work such as system modernization, a large-scale migration, or an ERP or billing platform implementation, and turning messy or incomplete inputs into a concrete plan with owners and dates; you're pulled into problems before they're scoped and you're as useful advising a controller on process design as an engineering lead on sequencing
Working understanding of data lifecycle and analytics tooling, and real experience running change management for business systems, not just launching them
Influence without authority and a bias toward closure. You have no direct reports, so you work through credibility and clear reasoning, knowing when to push and when to escalate; you chase ambiguous items to a decision, will reopen the uncomfortable question a week before launch, and communicate clearly with Director/VP+ stakeholders, including when the news is bad

Nice To Haves

Hands-on experience working in enterprise billing, ERP, and revenue systems such as NetSuite, Stripe, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how orders, invoices, and revenue data flow between them
Experience supporting an IPO readiness or first-year SOX program, including standing up ITGCs from scratch
CISA, CIA, or equivalent certification, or equivalent time embedded on an IT audit team
Experience building internal tooling or agents on a workspace platform rather than only configuring vendor systems

Strategic Planning Support: Play a key role in enterprise strategic planning process by conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, building financial and operational scenarios, and synthetizing insights into clear recommendations. Support quarterly, annual, and multi-year planning cycles by preparing executive and board level materials, coordinating inputs across business units, and ensuring that strategic priorities are well-defined, measurable, and aligned with business goals. Objective thought partner to senior level executives and support creation of CEO level executive communications. (25%)
Research and Market Intelligence: Conduct in-depth research on industry trends, competitor strategies, regulatory developments and member/partner needs. Transform complex research findings into actionable intelligence that highlights opportunities, risks, and implications for the organization’s long-term positioning. (20%)
Performance Tracking and Reporting: Design, maintain, and enhance enterprise dashboards, scorecards, and KPIs to monitor progress against strategic goals. Ensure executives and the board have timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into performance, enabling course corrections and accountability across the organization. Build robust data models in excel for dynamic scenario analysis that supports business cases and strategic priority analysis. (15%)
Business Case Development: Build financial and operational models to evaluate new initiatives, products, or partnerships. Provide clear analysis of expected ROI, risks, and alignment with organizational priorities, enabling leaders to make informed, data-driven investment decisions. (15%)
Executive and Board Materials: Prepare concise, high-quality presentations, reports, and briefing documents that translate complex data, analysis, and research into clear narratives. Provide executive leadership and the board with the insights that they need to evaluate progress, approve initiatives, and set direction. (15%)
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Operations, PMO & CMO, Product, and Data & Analytics teams to embed strategy into day-to-day execution. Facilitate alignment between departments, clarify ownership of initiatives, and ensure strategic priorities are advanced through coordinated, cross-functional action. Reports gaps in policies, procedures, and operating controls to leadership to ensure member impact and risk is mitigated. (10%)

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, or related field. Masters Degree or MBA preferred.
3-5 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, finance, analytics, or related roles with demonstrated ability to conduct research, develop business cases, and support executive decision-making.
Experience supporting strategic planning processes and developing board ready materials in a corporate, financial services, or consulting environment.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Experience in applying data analysis to solve business problems in fast-moving environments.
Strategic Planning Tools & Frameworks: Proficiency in frameworks such as SWOT, PESTLE, Porter’s Five Forces, balanced scorecards, and OKRs to evaluate organizational positioning and define priorities.
Financial & Quantitative Analysis: Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills; ability to build ROI models, sensitivity analyses, and scenario forecasts to support business cases and strategy recommendations.
Research & Competitive Intelligence: Ability to conduct primary and secondary research, synthesize market trends, competitor moves, and regulatory developments into actionable insights.
Communication & Storytelling: Strong skills in developing executive-ready presentations and board materials that translate complex data and analysis into clear, compelling narratives.

Data Analysis & Visualization: Skilled in extracting, analyzing, and presenting data using BI and visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar). Comfortable with SQL for querying and joining datasets; preferred.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Sr. Spclst, Data Business Analyst

The Opportunity

Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
Be part of an organization driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Data Scientist / Business Analyst to join the HTC team. In this role, you will have the unique opportunity to collaborate in developing robust data standards and ontologies while serving as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams. You will play a critical role in translating laboratory, quality, and operational needs into clearly defined, testable, and traceable requirements, ensuring our data ecosystems are connected, contextualized, and compliant.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Alignment

Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to bridge the gap between laboratory operations and IT solutions.
Translate laboratory, quality, and operational needs into clearly defined, testable, and traceable requirements.
Own end-to-end requirements lifecycle management, business process definition, and ensure strict traceability between intended business outcomes and delivered system functionality.
Ensure integration solutions align with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and end‑user workflows.

Data Strategy, Ontologies, & Contextualization

Develop and document data‑standardization strategies, ontology utilization guidelines, and application‑governance practices for LIMS and LES data objects to enable harmonized, FAIR‑aligned data management.
Support and orchestrate the alignment of chromatographic ASM structures between Research and Manufacturing divisions to ensure consistent standards, terminology, and execution logic across domains.

Systems Architecture & Integration

Lead the design and facilitation of cross‑platform data‑flow architectures spanning environments such as Biovia LES, CISPro, MODA-EM, Empower, and enterprise data lakes.
Ensure seamless integration delivery through platforms including Scitara DLX, Empower, BIOVIA, MODA-EM, SoftMaxPro, Labware LIMS, and LabX.

Risk Management & Governance

Independently conduct data‑strategy risk assessments.
Clearly communicate assessment findings to project leadership, ensuring proactive visibility into system, workflow, and interoperability risks.

Qualifications & Skills

Proven experience in Business Analysis or Data Science within a laboratory, scientific, or pharmaceutical environment.
Strong understanding of FAIR data principles, ontologies, and data contextualization.
Familiarity with lab informatics and integration platforms (e.g., Scitara DLX, Empower, BIOVIA, Labware LIMS, LabX, CISPro, MODA-EM, SoftMaxPro).
Exceptional ability to define and manage business processes, requirements lifecycles, and cross-functional traceability.
Strong analytical, communication, and risk-assessment capabilities.

Education & Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (preferred fields Engineering, Life Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline).
5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst in regulated environments (pharmaceutical, life sciences, or manufacturing preferred).
Demonstrated experience working within SDLC and validation frameworks (GxP, cGMP).
Strong understanding of lab operations, quality systems, or laboratory informatics.
Excellent written, verbal, and facilitation skills.
Ability to work independently and influence across organizational boundaries.

Preferred Experience

Experience supporting lab systems (Empower, BIOVIA, MODA-EM, LabwareLIMS, Scitara DLX).
Certified PMI-PBA or IIBA-CBAP or CCBA
Familiarity with change control processes (e.g. Veeva) and digital SDLC (e.g. Kneat).
Experience with digital workflows, data integrity, and compliance‑driven implementations.
Hands‑on experience with Jira, Confluence, and requirements traceability tools (e.g., Xray).

Who We Are

We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.

What We Look For

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

Required Skills

Asset Management, Benefits Management, Business Processes, Business Process Management (BPM), Business Process Modeling, Business Requirements Analysis, Computer Science, Data Integrity, Data Strategies, Laboratory Informatics, Management System Development, Product Management, Project Leadership, Requirements Management, Stakeholder Analysis, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Strategic Planning, System Designs, Systems Architecture, Working Independently

new_jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Project Manager (AI Products) based in Brazil.

This is a hands-on Technical Project Management opportunity for a professional who can lead AI-enabled products from discovery through launch and iteration. You will combine delivery leadership with strong business analysis skills, turning complex business, clinical, and market goals into clear, actionable requirements. The role offers substantial ownership across scope, planning, stakeholder alignment, quality, governance, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineering teams and need enough technical fluency to engage confidently in architecture discussions and challenge assumptions. The environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and focused on measurable outcomes rather than simply managing schedules. You will also have opportunities to introduce automation, AI tooling, and efficient processes that improve delivery quality and reduce operational overhead.

Accountabilities

Lead AI-first projects end-to-end, from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
Translate business, clinical, and market objectives into clear, actionable, and technically feasible requirements.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues while maintaining strong delivery discipline.
Coordinate standups, Scrum ceremonies, stakeholder communications, project updates, and vendor activities as required.
Develop and maintain business analysis deliverables, including epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, gap analyses, and functional documentation.
Work closely with engineering teams to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions, understand technical architecture discussions, and remove delivery blockers.
Establish UAT plans, coordinate testing activities, prepare cutover plans and runbooks, and ensure teams are ready for production releases.
Track KPIs and OKRs, evaluate project outcomes, and use retrospective feedback to continuously improve delivery processes.
Establish project governance frameworks, including RACI structures, change-control processes, documentation standards, risk management, and privacy checklists.
Build dashboards, templates, and AI-powered automations that reduce project management overhead and improve visibility into delivery performance.
Maintain efficient task prioritization, delegation, and execution using project and collaboration tools such as ClickUp, Basecamp, Mattermost, Slack, and instant messaging.
Monitor delivery performance against agreed targets, with a strong focus on achieving projects on time and within scope.
Produce clear, concise documentation that reduces ambiguity, minimizes rework, and accelerates engineering throughput.
Act as a trusted bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, and other project participants.

Requirements

5–8+ years of experience in Technical Project Management, Project Management, and/or Business Analysis.
At least 3 years of demonstrated experience managing fast-paced projects involving multiple stakeholders and concurrent delivery priorities.
Proven experience delivering cloud-based or AI-enabled products or features in close collaboration with engineering teams.
Strong business analysis capabilities, including requirements elicitation, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, and gap analysis.
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to understand architecture discussions, communicate effectively with developers, and independently structure delivery plans.
Demonstrated ability to maintain a 90%+ delivery rate within projected timelines.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a strong ability to turn complex information into clear and actionable documentation.
Strong organizational skills, including prioritization, delegation, time management, and risk management.
Experience with project management and collaboration tools; familiarity with ClickUp is particularly relevant.
Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions, and maintain delivery momentum in a high-growth environment.
Strong understanding of project governance, quality management, UAT, release readiness, KPI tracking, and retrospective processes.
Experience using automation or AI tools to improve project management workflows is a plus.
Experience delivering health or clinical products, regulated-data projects, or other highly controlled environments is desirable.
Familiarity with automated KPI dashboards and AI-enabled PM workflows is an advantage.

Benefits

USD $1,000–$1,500 per month base contractor fee.
Performance incentives, including an annual bonus for KPI over-performance.
Independent contractor engagement with monthly invoicing.
Payment in USD through direct bank deposit.
Fully remote work.
Significant ownership across product discovery, delivery, and iteration.
Opportunity to work on AI-enabled products across health, wellbeing, education, and enterprise.
End-to-end exposure spanning business analysis, product strategy, delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and user insights.
Opportunity to introduce AI and automation into project management and delivery processes.
Fast-growth environment with opportunities for increased responsibility as the organization scales.
Practical, impact-oriented work focused on helping teams operate more intentionally, transparently, and effectively.

You will step into a pivotal leadership role managing multiple high-value commercial architectural metal and glass projects from pre-construction through final closeout. Joining an established company with a 67-year legacy, you will drive project success while fostering strong collaborative relationships with top architects and general contractors. This position empowers you to make a lasting structural impact on major commercial landscapes within a supportive, family-oriented corporate culture.

Oversee 8 to 15 commercial architectural metal and glass projects simultaneously from initial award through final closeout.
Drive project schedules, material procurement logs, and labor allocation to ensure all phases remain on track and within budget.
Cultivate trusted, transparent relationships with general contractors, architects, and field teams through proactive and honest communication.
Manage complex financial landscapes including cost controls, forecasting, regular billings, change orders, and overall project profitability.
Coordinate seamlessly with estimating, drafting, fabrication, and installation departments to streamline material lead times and sequencing.
Resolve real-time technical hurdles and logistical conflicts on active jobsites under fast-paced, high-pressure construction conditions.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Minimum of 3 years of dedicated project management experience within the architectural metal, glazing, storefront, or curtain wall industry.
Deep technical knowledge of commercial interior and exterior glazing systems, custom metal, fabrication processes, and installation methods.
Proven ability to interpret and extract detailed data from architectural drawings, shop drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications.
Demonstrated track record of successfully managing a high volume of complex commercial construction projects at one time.
High proficiency with modern construction management technology including Procore, ACC Autodesk, Bluebeam, or equivalent software platforms.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a closely related field is preferable but not required.
7 or more years of related work experience in commercial glazing and specialty architectural metals.

Active OSHA safety certification
AutoCAD knowledge helpful
Strong, established working network and direct project experience within the New York City and tri-state area construction market.

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Bridge Inspection Project Manager/Team Leader
for our Northeast Region Bridge Inspection Group.
This position is based out of our Valhalla, New York
office with flexibility to work from other WSP offices in New York. You will work closely with our New York Bridge Inspection Group Lead on a full-time basis with project management, business development and winning bridge/structure inspection and load rating work for state, transit and local clients. You will be expected to lead structural inspections, as required, while we grow this region’s bridge inspection group. Travel may be required for client interaction and structural inspections.

You will utilize your education, professional engineering licensure, NHI/FHWA bridge/structure inspection certifications, and relevant work experience to perform inspections of bridges, culverts, tunnels, ancillary structures, retaining walls, and other structures for our clients. Bridge and tunnel inspection/reporting will typically performed per NBIS/NTIS standards and individual client guidance. Non-NBIS structure inspection/reporting may also be performed. Inspection reports will utilize various asset management software (AASHTOWare BrM, etc.) and may require recommendations for prioritized maintenance, repair, rehabilitation, replacement, and/or load rating update.

Grow and strengthen WSP's bridge inspection practice throughout the Northeast Region through strategic business development and client engagement.
Build and maintain strong relationships with state DOTs, transit agencies, local governments, and other key transportation clients.
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, providing technical leadership and practical solutions for bridge and structural asset management.
Lead project teams, managing scope, budget, schedule, staffing, subcontractors, and quality performance.
Oversee the preparation and review of inspection reports, engineering recommendations, and asset management deliverables.
Lead technical aspects of proposals, pursuit activities, contract negotiations, presentations, and interviews.
Support regional growth initiatives through market analysis, opportunity identification, forecasting, and pipeline development.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative and future-ready infrastructure solutions.
Mentor, develop, and provide leadership to bridge inspection staff and emerging professionals.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, industry standards, QA/QC procedures, and safety requirements.

130087 Inspection and Maintenance of Ancillary Highway Structures.

OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour Training

Description

At 1898 & Co., we are helping shape the future of the power system across North America. Our Transmission Planning & Power Systems Analysis (TPPSA) and Grid Modernization & Distribution Planning (GMDP) teams work with a diverse mix of clients—investor-owned utilities, public power entities, developers, and ISOs/RTOs—to deliver smart, resilient, and future-ready electric grid solutions for both the transmission and distribution systems. As part of Burns & McDonnell, we bring decades of experience, a deep bench of technical talent, and a spirit of innovation to solve some of the most critical infrastructure challenges of our time. Our New England organization is looking for a Project Delivery Manager who will lead an execution team within our Transmission Planning & Power Systems Analysis and/or Grid Modernization & Distribution Planning business lines. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone passionate about building strong teams, delivering high-quality consulting services, and supporting utility clients as they plan and evolve the transmission grid.

What You’ll Do

As a Project Delivery Manager (PDM), you will provide strategic and operational leadership to a team of consultants and analysts, supporting the execution of projects within the Transmission Planning & Power Systems Analysis and/or Grid Modernization & Distribution Planning business lines and adjacent service areas. You will work closely with managing directors and business line leads to ensure project excellence, staff development, and alignment with company goals and values. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Leadership & Team Development

Provide leadership to the team; direct and coordinate work assignments and review performance to ensure efficient, cost-effective utilization of staff.
Recruit, develop, train, and retain high-performing staff.
Conduct performance evaluations, monthly one-on-ones, and provide clear instruction and guidance to direct reports.
Promote the Burns & McDonnell culture, values, and mission, along with 1898 & Co.’s traits: tenacious problem solvers, curious seekers, unselfish collaborators, and grit.
Interpret and communicate organizational goals and policies to staff.

Project & Resource Management

Provide expert-level technical guidance and support for consulting engagements in transmission planning, distribution planning, and power systems analysis.
Support profitable growth by ensuring staff levels, loading, and assignments meet project requirements and billable targets.
Coordinate workload for the team and communicate staffing needs to business line leads and managing directors.
Lead and support project QA/QC efforts.
Ensure compliance with company and safety policies.

Strategic & Operational Execution

Implement and support firm-wide programs and initiatives; lead your team through organizational change.
Achieve stated financial targets and performance standards.
Collaborate with project managers, managing directors, and proposal teams to support business development and secure new work for the team.

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is seeking an experienced Program Manager (P7)
to support a major transit agency in New York City
on large-scale fare payment, transit technology, and customer-facing mobility programs. This position will serve as the primary day-to-day project management lead, coordinating activities among clients, technology vendors, contractors, systems integrators, and stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

The successful candidate will provide leadership in project planning, schedule management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, executive reporting, governance, implementation oversight, and transition planning for complex transit technology programs. The role is comparable to WSP's support of major fare payment and transit modernization initiatives across New York, Philadelphia, Chicago, San Francisco, and Miami.

This position requires a proven leader with extensive experience managing large, multi-disciplinary transportation technology programs, fare payment systems, account-based ticketing, open payments, customer technology platforms, and systems integration efforts. Candidates should possess strong client relationship skills and experience working directly with executive leadership at large public transportation agencies. Desired qualifications align closely with leadership experience supporting major transit fare modernization and payment system programs, including OMNY and similar initiatives.

Required Work Location

This position is required to be onsite in New York, NY five (5) days per week.

Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the New York City metropolitan area. Remote or hybrid arrangements are not anticipated for this role.

Position is contingent upon contract award.

Your Impact

Serve as Program Manager for major fare collection, transit technology, customer payment, and mobility projects.
Act as the primary WSP point of contact with client executives, technology vendors, contractors, and project stakeholders.
Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, control, and reporting activities throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop and maintain integrated master schedules, budgets, action item logs, risk registers, issue logs, and executive dashboards.
Coordinate activities among agency staff, technology providers, systems integrators, contractors, and subcontractors.
Facilitate executive steering committee meetings, stakeholder workshops, technical reviews, and governance meetings.
Monitor project performance and proactively identify schedule, budget, operational, and technical risks requiring management attention.
Prepare executive-level presentations, briefing materials, program updates, and Board-level reports.
Support project testing, system acceptance, operational readiness, implementation, transition planning, and go-live activities.
Lead stakeholder engagement, communications, and change management efforts.
Oversee vendor performance and coordinate cross-functional teams across technology, operations, finance, customer experience, and engineering disciplines.
Support procurement activities, contract administration, business case development, and strategic planning initiatives.
Mentor project managers and technical staff supporting major transit technology programs.
Support business development, capture planning, proposal development, and client relationship management activities.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Transportation, Construction Management, Planning, or a related field.
Minimum 12 years of progressively responsible project and program management experience.
Minimum 10 years managing large-scale transit, transportation technology, fare collection, intelligent transportation systems (ITS), payment systems, or technology implementation programs.
Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with budgets exceeding $50 million.
Experience overseeing system integration, software development, hardware deployment, testing, and implementation activities.
Strong program controls, risk management, governance, and reporting experience.
Proven ability to lead large, cross-functional teams and coordinate multiple concurrent workstreams.
Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience preparing executive briefings and presenting to senior leadership and agency executives.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

PMP Certification required or strongly preferred.
MBA or advanced degree in a related discipline.
Experience with fare payment systems, Automated Fare Collection (AFC), Account-Based Ticketing (ABT), contactless payments, open-loop payments, mobile ticketing, and transit retailing technologies.
Experience supporting major metropolitan transit agencies, including NYCT/MTA, SEPTA, CTA, MBTA, WMATA, Metra, NJ TRANSIT, SFMTA, BART, or similar agencies.
Experience supporting programs involving payment modernization, fare transformation, customer technology, and digital mobility services.
Familiarity with PMBOK project management practices and governance frameworks.
Experience using Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar project controls tools.
Understanding of systems engineering, software lifecycle management, cybersecurity, testing and commissioning, and operational readiness processes.
Experience with procurement support, DBOM/DBFOM contracts, or public-sector technology procurements.
Demonstrated success managing programs involving multiple vendors, contractors, and technology partners.
Existing relationships and experience working with large transit agencies and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Experience Profile

The ideal candidate will have successfully delivered major transit technology and payment transformation programs involving:

Contactless fare payment systems.
Open payment and account-based ticketing solutions.
Mobile applications and customer-facing technology platforms.
Transit operations technology deployments.
Systems integration and modernization initiatives.
Multi-year capital programs valued at $100M+.
Executive stakeholder management and governance.
Large-scale implementation and transition planning.

Individuals who have led delivery of major transit fare modernization programs for large public transportation agencies and possess a proven record of program execution, client relationship management, business development, and operational leadership are strongly encouraged to apply.

At 1898 & Co., we are helping shape the future of the power system across North America. Our Transmission Planning & Power Systems Analysis (TPPSA) and Grid Modernization & Distribution Planning (GMDP) teams work with a diverse mix of clients—investor-owned utilities, public power entities, developers, and ISOs/RTOs—to deliver smart, resilient, and future-ready electric grid solutions for both the transmission and distribution systems. As part of Burns & McDonnell, we bring decades of experience, a deep bench of technical talent, and a spirit of innovation to solve some of the most critical infrastructure challenges of our time. Our New England organization is looking for a Project Delivery Manager who will lead an execution team within our Transmission Planning & Power Systems Analysis and/or Grid Modernization & Distribution Planning business lines. This is a high-impact leadership role for someone passionate about building strong teams, delivering high-quality consulting services, and supporting utility clients as they plan and evolve the transmission grid.

Promote the Burns & McDonnell culture, values, and mission, along with 1898 & Co.’s traits: tenacious problem solvers, curious seekers, unselfish collaborators, and grit.

Support profitable growth by ensuring staff levels, loading, and assignments meet project requirements and billable targets.
Coordinate workload for the team and communicate staffing needs to business line leads and managing directors.

new_jobs.description:
Description

The Leidos National Airspace Systems (NAS) Integration Contract (NISC) Support Program is looking for a senior level Program Analyst to provide executive operation support for the Federal Aviation Administration's (FAA) Office of Government and Industry Affairs (AGI). AGI is the principal advisor to the Administrator and FAA Lines of Business/Staff Offices on all matters concerning the Congress, aviation industry groups, and other governmental organizations.

Specifically, this work provides executive level program analysis support for ASE executive leadership and senior management. The work directly supports the FAA’s safety mission and statutory requirements across multiple functional areas including safety oversight, security, and FAA Reauthorization implementation activities.

Potential for Telework: No.

Business Travel: No.

Primary Responsibilities

Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders across FAA, Department of Transportation (DOT), and other federal agencies.
Support executives and program technical actions for the FAA Administrators, management team, and staff, including logistical support, administrative briefings, and urgent action items.
Ensure work is compliant with FAA and ASE policies, orders, and guidelines, and that work products are completed timely, accurately, and within the scope of work.
Conduct in-depth research and analysis to lead and/or support FAA staff with special projects and routine tasks. Provide analytical input for management briefings and program reviews.
Compile and complete project documents, prepare required reports that highlight the major work completed by the organization, and prepare draft briefings to executive management, as required.
Directly responsible for the business operations of AGI to include full lifecycle meeting facilitation, logistical coordination for engagement sessions, and monitoring the office mailbox.
Utilize internal systems (e.g., SharePoint, Outlook, Teams, E2, Concur, or agency-specific tools) to manage workflows and communication.
Review, prepare, coordinate, and manage domestic and international travel arrangements, including processing country clearances, travel authorizations, and expense vouchers while adhering to federal travel guidance and budget parameters.
Provide full logistical support for meetings and/or teleconferences of various sizes to include preparing support materials, reserving meeting locations, taking accurate meeting minutes, following up with summary notes/minutes or reports from meetings, preparing and distributing summary notes from prior meetings to key stakeholders and meeting participants, and other duties as assigned.
Maintain office files, records, and logs—ensuring that routed document packets are accurate, signed, as well as reviewed and/or approved.
Conduct calendar maintenance and appointment scheduling for FAA executive leadership, management, and team.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelors degree and 4+ years of prior relevant experience or Masters with 2 - 6 years of prior relevant experience. Sufficient relevant experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
Excellent written communication skills are a must. This position requires the incumbent to proof, edit, and finalize official documents using independent discretion on completion and disbursement.
Ability to communicate to various levels of management, with the capacity to multi-task, strong organizational skills, budget adherence experience, and ability to organize meetings consisting of agency and external stakeholders with a broad range of specialties and interests including members from professional aviation organizations are required.
High proficiency in utilizing Microsoft Office applications to include Word, Excel, Teams, and PowerPoint.
Experience with editing and proofreading official documents.
Must be able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Security clearance.
Position requires in-person support five days a week, FAA or DOT Headquarters in Washington, DC. There is not a telework or remote option.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience working in federal government contracting.
Working knowledge of FAA systems, specifically, E2 Travel and Electronic Document Management System (EDMS).

new_jobs.title: Project Manager (Battery)
new_jobs.description:
Project management of batteries refers to a series of management activities involving planning, organizing, implementing and controlling during the battery production process. Manage the planning, resource allocation, progress control, risk management, quality assurance and other aspects of battery projects. During the battery mass production stage, pay attention to and solve the construction situation of the production line, and respond to various audits and demand inquiries from customers.

Job responsibilities:

Project Plan: Determine the project's goals, scope, schedule, resource requirements, etc., formulate a detailed project plan, and identify the critical path and milestones.
Resource management: Effectively allocate and schedule the human, material, financial and other resources required for the project to ensure its smooth progress.
Risk management: Identify potential risks that the project may face and formulate corresponding response strategies to reduce the impact of project risks on schedule and cost.
Progress control: Supervise the progress of the project, adjust the plan in a timely manner, and ensure the project is completed on schedule.
Quality Management: Ensure that the battery products delivered for the project meet quality standards, take corresponding quality control measures, and supervise and evaluate the project quality.
Communication Management: Establish a sound communication mechanism to ensure effective communication among project team members and with relevant stakeholders, promoting the smooth progress of the project.

Job Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Battery Engineering, Materials, Industrial Engineering or other related disciplines.
Fluent bilingual capability in both Chinese and English; capable of independently drafting project documents, holding online/offline customer audit meetings and daily business communication in English.
Solid full-cycle battery project management experience, familiar with new product introduction (NPI) and mass production delivery processes of power/energy storage batteries.
Able to travel moderately as required by project and customer needs.
